newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's CPI rose 1.15 percent in October.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's CPI rose 1.15 percent in October.

text.p: Colombia's consumer price index rose a sharper-than-expected 1.15 percent in October, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said on Saturday.

As measured on an accumulated basis for the first nine months of the year, it said the index had now risen 19.80 percent, well over the 17 percent target the central bank originally set for the entire year.

The rise in the price index in October compares with a 0.88 percent increase in the same month last year. Real inflation this year is expected to exceed 21 percent, according to most independent analysts.
Inflation over the past 12 months stands at 21.87 percent, according to figures released by the DANE. This compares with a 20.52 percent increase between October 1994 and October 1995.
